title: 高速鐵路路線平縱面設計
titleEn: Horizontal and vertical alignment for high-speed rail
summary: 以「高速鐵路路線平縱面設計」為研究主題，規劃拆解土建與機電介面、系統整合、可靠度及測試。目前為選題路線圖，逐步課程與專案細節尚待編審；所附通用來源屬類別背景。
summaryEn: Study topic: Horizontal and vertical alignment for high-speed rail. Planned coverage includes civil–electromechanical interfaces, system integration, reliability and testing. Roadmap entry: step-by-step lessons and project details await editorial review; general references provide category context.
